sql: WITH rag_postings AS (SELECT DISTINCT posting_key FROM posting_skills WHERE skill = 'RAG'), all_remote_us_postings AS (SELECT fp.posting_key, fp.comp_mid_usd FROM fct_posting AS fp WHERE fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us) SELECT 'Mentions RAG' AS category, MEDIAN(arp.comp_mid_usd) AS median_comp_mid_usd FROM all_remote_us_postings AS arp JOIN rag_postings AS rp ON arp.posting_key = rp.posting_key WHERE arp.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Does Not Mention RAG' AS category, MEDIAN(arp.comp_mid_usd) AS median_comp_mid_usd FROM all_remote_us_postings AS arp LEFT JOIN rag_postings AS rp ON arp.posting_key = rp.posting_key WHERE rp.posting_key IS NULL AND arp.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL
